title: Headcount: decide a held group
description: The council's decision on one group of recipients the screener held: pay all of them, pay one and send the rest back, or send the whole group back to the treasury. Headcount accepts this only from the treasury itself, so it takes this vote.

fields.name: group
fields.label: Group number
fields.help: As get_round numbers the held groups, counting from 1.

fields.name: decision
fields.label: Decision, as JSON
fields.help: "ReleaseAll" pays every account in the group. "Refund" sends the group's amounts back to the treasury. {"ReleaseOne": {"account_id": "alice.near"}} pays that one account and sends the rest back.
